sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Because you are in need of some compassion and support, you will feel the need to spend time with friends and relatives. Your beloved or better half may bring a change in mood by helping you shed your negative frame of mind, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Short visits in your neighborhood could catapult you into some negative situations, Taurus. It's best to stay close to home if you can. An angry letter or call could put you in a shaky mood. This isn't a day to socialize. Days like this are best spent keeping to yourself and throwing your energy into taking care of whatever you're working on.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Don't be shocked to find your dreams have suddenly come true, dearest Taurus. As outer planets Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus activate, visions that once felt far away could manifest right before your eyes. If you don't see any obvious changes on the horizon, use this energy to make headway on goals that need a little more time to actualize. You'll operate at a higher level when the Leo quarter Moon and Saturn align this afternoon. Solitude and a quiet home amplify these sentiments, so block out distractions. Just try not to hole up for too long, or you may begin to feel isolated when Mercury rx activates tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Tension at home would make you angry. Suppressing them would only increase physical problem. Get rid of it with physical activity. It is better to leave the irritating situation. Traders and Businessmen who have relations with foreign countries are likely to lose money today, so think carefully before taking any step forward. Evenings with friends- or shopping will be highly pleasurable and exciting. Secret affairs can ruin your reputation. A spiritual leader or an elder provides guidance. You might experience a tough and bold side of your spouse today, which might make you feel uncomfortable. A day to catch up with your friends who you have not met for a long time. But inform your friend in advance if you want to meet, or a lot of time might be wasted.

readings.text: Keep your nerve cool under pressure today, warns Ganesha. You will be able to accomplish your tasks only if you are in a balanced state of mind. New opportunities will call upon you to use your presence of mind and transform thoughts into action.

You cannot fully trust other people's word. People may say one thing now, and promise you the world, but for them to deliver on this promise is another story. The bottom line is that they have their own agenda in mind - not yours. Watch out.

readings.text: You will just have to remain satisfied with what you are earning in regular course and that should put you at ease too. Putting in too much effort or devoting much time to anything else wouldn’t work in your favour.

You have energy directed toward groups, politics, and self-employment. You have all the friends and contacts you need to begin a new venture, whether product, service, or project at your current job. You will also meet new people who can help you get where you want to be financially. At the same time, you're augmenting and transforming your union with other people. You have all the tools you need to get ahead.

readings.text: Ganesha says that you shall politely interact with one and all today. As a result, your colleagues, associates, friends, relatives and family will feel very glad. Your positive vibes will spread around, and they shall also behave nicely with you.

When something is bothering you, but you can't put your finger on what (like today), check in to see if your body is over-extended. Remember that the balancing act you accomplish on a daily basis can be very wearing on your body. You can help keep your balance from fresh juices: and I'm talking about the hard stuff: carrot, apple and ginger is a great mix for cleansing the kidneys (the organs responsible for balancing our bodies). In addition, you may want to stay out of the fray at home or work; if you see an argument or misunderstanding brewing, tell yourself it's not your responsibility to fix it.

extras.text: Today offers you a chance to break a bad habit -- sacrifices you make will pay off.
